name: Stash
tagline: Your Spotify and YouTube Music library, offline in FLAC
description:
Stash copies the playlists, liked songs and daily mixes from your Spotify and YouTube Music accounts onto your phone. Pick what you want, and it either downloads each track as a lossless FLAC file or builds a light streaming index instead, which uses almost no storage but needs a connection to play.

There is no Stash account, no subscription and no ads. Your logins stay encrypted on the device, and you get a five-band equaliser, crossfade, volume levelling, synced lyrics from LRCLIB and optional Last.fm scrobbling.

You need your own Spotify and YouTube Music accounts. The audio files come from third-party lossless sources rather than from Spotify itself, so what you end up with depends on what those sources have. It wants Android 8 or newer, and you install it from the project's own releases rather than an app store.
